chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, I have transmitted from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan.
He is the one who was mentioned in the presence of al-Sadiq عليه السلام, and he said: “Indeed, he exceeds old age in goodness.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam in whose presence Abdullah ibn Sinan was mentioned
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: the Himyari lineage designation in the chain of transmission
key_terms.خَيْرًا: goodness, virtue, or excellence in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abdullah ibn Sinan in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abdullah ibn Sinan in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It also preserves a brief praise from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام about Abdullah ibn Sinan, indicating his virtue and goodness.
